notebooks.title: 按行与按列计算
notebooks.contract: assert A*u == sp.Matrix([3,4]); assert u[0]*A[:,0] == sp.Matrix([2,2]); assert u[1]*A[:,1] == sp.Matrix([1,2]); assert A*sp.zeros(2,1) == sp.zeros(2,1)

notebooks.title: 核对乘法顺序
notebooks.contract: assert A*B == sp.Matrix([[1,2],[1,4]]); assert B*A == sp.Matrix([[1,1],[2,4]]); assert A*(B*u) == sp.Matrix([4,6]); assert B*(A*u) == sp.Matrix([3,8])

notebooks.title: 求解并检查秩
notebooks.contract: assert A.LUsolve(y) == sp.Matrix([2,1]); assert A.rank()==2 and C.rank()==1; assert C.row_join(y).rank()==2; assert sp.linsolve((C,y))==sp.EmptySet; assert A.det()==1 and C.det()==0; assert A.inv()==sp.Matrix([[2,-1],[-1,1]]); assert sp.simplify(candidate*M)==sp.eye(2); assert aug==sp.Matrix([[1,2,3],[0,0,1]])

notebooks.title: 核对正文与七题答案
notebooks.contract: assert A*sp.Matrix([-1,2])==sp.Matrix([1,3]); assert A.LUsolve(sp.Matrix([5,8]))==sp.Matrix([2,3]); assert C*sp.Matrix([6-2*r,r])==sp.Matrix([6,6]); assert C.row_join(sp.Matrix([6,6])).rank()==1 and C.row_join(sp.Matrix([6,5])).rank()==2; assert p.dot(q)==0 and p.norm()==sp.sqrt(2); assert p*q.T==sp.Matrix([[1,1],[-1,-1]]); assert F*sp.Matrix([1,2])+G*(-2)==sp.Matrix([3,0]); assert F*sp.Matrix([2,1])+G*(-1)==sp.Matrix([3,0])
